status: fixed before evaluating new generation seeds 11 and 12
feature_score: sum(abs(x))^2 / sum(x^2), stable row scaling, zero mapped to zero
reference_nodes: unique observed supervised and validation identities; no labels in calibration
candidate_rule: receiver of at least one positive-weight direction deleted by original ABP
detection_rule: candidate has at least one blocked sender whose support score exceeds threshold
label_rule: omit detected receivers from supervised loss and validation model selection
projection_anchors: all original observed supervised identities, including flagged receivers
projection_policy: always apply positive-edge ABP, in training, clean evaluation and triggered evaluation
stress: remove all positive internal generated-node edges, retain single receiver attachment
interpretation: fixed-snapshot development followed by new generator-seed validation on the same fixed Cora node split (utils.get_split uses RandomState(10)); not independent graphs, independent node splits, or proof of universal detectability
